data.title: American Society of Hematology Names Matthew Gertzog Chief Executive Officer; Martha Liggett to Retire After Three Decades of Leadership
data.description: On August 7, 2026, the American Society of Hematology revealed that Matthew Gertzog, FASAE, MBA, is set to become the organization's new CEO starting January 1, 2027. Gertzog will be taking over from Martha "Marty" Liggett, Esq., in this role.

data.title: Here Come Bold Stripes and Bright Stars
data.description: In Linthicum Heights, Maryland on August 7, 2026, the U.S. Postal Service unveiled its latest postage envelope at the BALPEX stamp show. The new Diagonal U.S. Flag Forever envelope showcases a patriotic red, white, and blue digital design depicting the American flag.

data.title: Pulse Health Launches Pulse Media, Bringing Precision HCP Advertising to the Pulse Engagement Cloud
data.description: Pulse Health, a prominent provider of cloud-based engagement technology for the life sciences sector, has introduced a new service that integrates precise digital media strategies with synchronized omnichannel outreach to enhance the engagement of healthcare professionals. The offering was unveiled on August 7, 2026 in Garden City, N.Y. This innovative approach aims to significantly improve interaction with healthcare professionals, leveraging targeted digital media tactics alongside coordinated omnichannel outreach. Pulse Health's focus on streamlining engagement is set to revolutionize how the industry connects with healthcare professionals.

data.title: Keys Inc. Launches AI-Powered Nationwide Key Distribution Network for Locksmiths
data.description: Keys Inc., based in Tucson, Arizona, announced on August 7, 2026, that they are facilitating direct connections between locksmiths and key distributors. Their AI-powered platform assists in identifying the right key, comparing local supply options, placing instant orders, and obtaining inventory swiftly. This service aims to streamline the process for locksmiths and promote efficiency in acquiring keys.

data.title: In HelloNation, Luxury Real Estate Expert Jud Whitlock Explains How Estate Planning Turns Property Into a Legacy
data.description: A recent article discusses the significance of tax and estate planning for affluent homeowners in safeguarding their property and family wealth for the future. The article, published on August 7, 2026 in Atlanta, underscores the importance of estate planning for luxury homeowners. It highlights the role of proper planning in preserving assets and wealth for the next generations, emphasizing the need for careful consideration and strategic financial decisions. Utilizing specific strategies can help affluent individuals mitigate tax obligations and ensure a smooth transfer of assets to heirs, thereby securing their legacy.

data.title: In HelloNation, Experienced Financial Planner Paula Fox Derwick Compares Roth and Traditional IRAs for Retirement Planning
data.description: A recent article highlighted the significance of tax treatment, income, and withdrawal rules in choosing between Roth IRA and Traditional IRA for supporting retirement goals effectively. The information was disclosed in OLEAN, N.Y. on Aug. 7, 2026. It shed light on the disparities between the two types of IRAs and offered guidance on selecting the more suitable option based on individual circumstances. It emphasized considering factors like tax implications, income levels, and withdrawal regulations to make an informed decision.

data.title: Duke Energy is helping North Carolina customers manage energy costs during extreme summer heat
data.description: The National Weather Service has issued a warning for elevated temperatures and humidity in select areas of North Carolina in the forthcoming week. Duke Energy has announced the availability of bill management tools and financial assistance options for customers struggling to cope with the heat. Residents in Charlotte, N.C., can access these resources to manage energy costs effectively during the anticipated high temperatures.

data.title: Unicharm Announces "DELECTABLES®" is the #1 Global Wet Cat Treat Brand, Accelerates Pet Care Expansion
data.description: Unicharm Corporation disclosed that their wet cat treat brand, "DELECTABLES®," created and managed by their U.S. subsidiary, The Hartz Mountain Corporation, has been acknowledged as the top Global Wet Cat Treat Brand*. The announcement aligns with International Cat Day on August 8. In addition to this milestone, Unicharm is presenting updates on its pet care sector's progress and recent endeavors to improve. The company's stock is listed as TOKYO: 8113.
